title: memoforge lint.json / citations.json
description: Deterministic checker report; the same shape serves `mf draft lint` (L-rules) and `mf draft audit-citations` (C-rules). `clean` is true when there is no blocker finding (TZ v1.5 section 5.4).

draft_sha.description: sha of the draft the findings belong to; consumers refuse a report whose sha is stale.

rule.description: L-01..L-15 lint, C-01..C-09 citation audit, B-01..B-10 decision-brief lint.

severity.description: `info` is a finding that is recorded but neither blocks nor counts as a defect (D34-10); no rule grades `info` since D-243.

line.description: 1-based line in the draft; null for findings that are not bound to a line (for example C-07).

excerpt.description: The draft text the finding points at; null when the finding could not be located in the draft (D34-10).

source_id.description: C-09 only (D-204): the id the `[[src:]]` token names, whose saved text lacks the number.

pinpoint.description: C-09 only (D-204): the pinpoint as the draft wrote it; the appendix line prints it.
